lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 (CAM-388 review round 1) fixed the second reviewer finding: isDashCWrapper (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts) matched ANY '-c' flag token preceding a quote via the bare regex /(?:^|\s)-c\s*$/, not an interpreter's own -c as its docstring claimed -- so a non-interpreter command's -c flag (grep -c 'test $X -eq 41' file.ts, npx tool -c 'threshold -eq 5') got its quoted payload UNWRAPPED and re-scanned as if it were live shell, tripping frozen-comparand on what is actually inert quoted test data (a grep search pattern). This is exactly the false-positive class CAM-388 exists to close, and 'grep -c' is a first-class idiom already used elsewhere in this same module (GREP_COUNT_GUARD_RE at line ~400, 'grep -c ... -ge N'). Fix: introduced SHELL_INTERPRETER_DASH_C_RE = /(?:^|[\s\/])(?:sh|bash|zsh|dash)\s+-c\s*$/ and isDashCWrapper now requires the text immediately preceding the -c flag to be one of those four recognized shell-interpreter words (optionally preceded by a path separator, so '/bin/bash -c ...' still matches). 'grep -c ...' and 'npx tool -c ...' no longer match (their quoted payload correctly falls through to ordinary quoted-span deletion, never unwrapped/rescanned), while 'sh -c', 'bash -c', 'zsh -c', 'dash -c', and '/bin/bash -c' wrappers are unaffected and still get their live shell payload unwrapped and scanned (verified against the existing US-R1-001 escaped-idiom and unterminated-quote fixture rows, both still flag correctly). Two new fixture rows added to test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt (both 'ok', i.e. NOT flagged): 'grep -c ... -eq 41 ...' and 'npx tool -c ... -eq 5 ...', reproducing the reviewer's exact two named examples. Docstrings for isDashCWrapper, stripQuotedSpans, and the module header comment updated to describe the interpreter-word scoping. Verified by bun test (58/58 pass in prd-oracle-lint.test.ts, full suite 5230/5230 pass) and full bun run check:all spine green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). No external library touched (pure internal regex/TS logic); Step 5.5 recorded as no_external_lib_touched. scripts/cam/prd.json is not edited by this story per the 'supervisor is sole writer of passes' rule -- any further review-round findings will again be queued into prd.json by the supervisor/reviewer, not by this session.
